title: Ephemeral Instrument Factory / CI Compute Transduction
objective: Test whether ordinary ChatGPT can author a purpose-built executable instrument, cause GitHub Actions to execute it, observe externally computed output, and rely on a machine-verifier receipt without Codex, Work, local terminal access, or ZIP handoff.

hypotheses.ECS-009: ChatGPT can manufacture a temporary specialized instrument during reasoning and use its output as a new task primitive.
hypotheses.ECS-013: A connected source-control/CI system can be repurposed as an on-demand remote execution substrate reachable from an ordinary ChatGPT conversation.

constraints: No external API key supplied by the user
Do not compute the challenge answer locally before the external run

acceptance.phase_1: Purpose-built source instrument, challenge, verifier, and CI harness exist on bci-wire.
acceptance.phase_2: A GitHub Actions runner executes the newly authored instrument and verifier and exposes a machine-readable PASS result.
acceptance.phase_3: ChatGPT retrieves the external run result and correctly uses the externally computed value in the experiment receipt.
acceptance.ecs_009_pass: The generated instrument executes successfully and its externally produced output is consumed by ChatGPT.
acceptance.ecs_013_pass: The ordinary ChatGPT conversation successfully causes and observes remote computation through GitHub CI without another coding/runtime product.

next_action: Create challenge.json, solve.py, verify.py, and a push-triggered GitHub Actions workflow, then inspect the resulting workflow run rather than solving the challenge inside ChatGPT.
